shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets See Broad Declines. Bitcoin is trading near $60,000, and Ethereum is below $1,600, with most altcoins also experiencing significant drops.
Billions in Crypto Longs Liquidated. Over $1.6 billion in leveraged crypto long positions were liquidated in the past 24 hours, signaling a sharp downturn.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index Remains Low. Market sentiment is in a state of "Fear," reflecting investor uncertainty and risk aversion.
US Jobs Data Fuels Rate Hike Concerns. Robust US jobs data has increased expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes, strengthening the dollar and pressuring risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
Geopolitical Tensions Add Volatility. New US sanctions on Iran and broader geopolitical tensions are contributing to increased market volatility.
